assessments.reasoning: The publisher archive links the exact 15.0 HTML, whose title identifies the ECMAScript 2024 Language Specification. The PDF cover independently identifies the June 2024 edition. The freshly acquired exact publisher bytes match the frozen SHA-256 eabb3c1fc6c5b0610b143ef7bea8de7c0f323a777d669a453e47c39a2986c846. The Early Errors clause gives the exact condition for an absent Initializer in a constant LexicalDeclaration. For the plain BindingIdentifier production the missing initializer creates a static Syntax Error, independently of execution. The exact LexicalBinding and IsConstantDeclaration conditions in the frozen record match the controlling 15th-edition production. ForDeclaration in the same edition uses ForBinding for for-in and for-of, so those initializer-free forms do not contradict the ordinary lexical-declaration claim. The separately acquired Corrigendum 1 replaces the copyright notice without altering this clause.

limitations: A bare for-in or for-of declaration uses a distinct production. This early error concerns a binding initializer, independently of mutability of the initialized value.
